name: court-civil-first-instance-filing
name_zh: 法院民事一审在线立案
name_en: Court Civil First Instance Online Filing
description: 登录法院诉讼服务平台并完成民事一审在线立案全链路：登录、建草稿、案由/当事人/代理人/标的额、材料上传、诉请、提交、状态查询。
description_zh: 登录法院诉讼服务平台（默认 zxfw.court.gov.cn，兼容同构各地法院网），完成民事一审在线立案全链路：SM2 登录、建草稿、匹配法院、案由/当事人/代理人/标的额、材料上传（签名→OSS→槽位）、诉请、人工确认后提交、按 id 查状态。凭证零硬编码。
description_en: Log in to court litigation platforms and complete civil first-instance online filing: SM2 login, draft, court match, cause/parties/agent/amount, material upload, claims, confirm-then-submit, status query by filing id.
examples_zh: 登录我的法院诉讼服务平台账号，准备立一个民事一审案
帮我起草一起民间借贷纠纷的民事一审立案材料
查询我刚提交的立案申请当前状态
examples_en: Log in to my court litigation service account to prepare a civil first-instance filing
Draft civil first-instance filing materials for a loan dispute
Query the current status of my just-submitted filing
